claim_ceiling: A scalar counterfactual evaluator for supplied measurements and externally qualified receipts. No laboratory randomization, physical reset/purge, raw PIV reanalysis, tracer model or thrust validation is claimed.

research_basis.methodological_observation: The study describes sequential clean-air, DEHS and incense-smoke conditions and reports collector deposition/current evolution, motivating explicit time-order, surface-reset and purge controls.
research_basis.raw_data_access: Generated data available from corresponding author on reasonable request; not independently reprocessed in this programme.

design.period_timing: strictly increasing; control and diagnostic mean times equal within declared tolerance
design.drift_property: symmetric timing cancels first-order linear within-block drift; balanced ABBA/BAAB assignment counterbalances a common quadratic component under cohort assumptions
design.sequence_balance: ABBA and BAAB independent-cluster counts differ by at most one
design.independence_unit: highest defensible acquisition/common-cause cluster; repeated blocks within one cluster are averaged before campaign inference

estimator.cluster_aggregation: equal-weight average of block effects within each independent cluster
estimator.campaign_aggregation: equal-weight average of independent cluster means
estimator.sampling_uncertainty: cluster-level standard error and approximate Student-t 95 percent margin, t=2.093 for n>=20
estimator.total_uncertainty: statistical 95 percent margin plus mean conservative absolute measurement bound
estimator.passivity_rule: full uncertainty interval must fit inside predeclared equivalence tolerance; non-significance is not a pass
